title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00059 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Continued displacing cement w/ 12,2 m3 SW. Stopped pumping. Observed 14 bar back pressure in DP, no pressure on annulus.
00:15 - 01:30: Opened BOP and stung out of EZSV plug. B/o and l/d pump-in sub. Installed sponge ball and pumped 9,5 m3 SW at 1500 LPM 7 bar.
01:30 - 01:45: R/b 1 STD. Dropped 3" drift.
01:45 - 02:00: Removed master bushing. Installed PS-21 slips. Turned off TT pump
02:00 - 03:15: POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 850 m to surface. Average pulling speed 680 m/hr.
03:15 - 03:45: Removed drift. Installed master bushing
03:45 - 04:00: L/d EZSV RT. Found 1 bow on EZSV RT bow-centralizer missing.
04:00 - 07:00: WOC meanwhile serviced drilling equipment.
07:00 - 10:30: WOC meanwhile serviced drilling equipment and prepared fishing tools removed masterbushing and inspected diverter and BOP for lost centralizer piece. No findings. performed periodic maintenace on drilling equipment
10:30 - 10:45: WOC meanwhile performed TBT for building magnet BHA and retrieving centralizer piece.
10:45 - 12:15: WOC meanwhile p/u casing hanger mill assy. B/o string magnet, l/d milling assy. Installed bitsub and flat bottom magnet in fox hole. M/u magnet BHA in rotary.
12:15 - 12:30: WOC meanwhile removed master bushing. Installed PS-12 slips
12:30 - 14:15: WOC meanwhile RIH w/ magnet BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 7 m to 879m. Restricted running speed 2 min/std.
14:15 - 14:30: WOC meanwhile recorded up/down weight 95/89 ton. Continued RIH, took 12 ton weight 2,5 m shallower than EZSV plug at 889m observed wob decreased, possibly soft cement on top of EZSV plug.
14:30 - 15:45: WOC meanwhile POOH w/ magnet BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 889 m to 47 m. Restricted pulling speed 2 min/std.
15:45 - 16:00: WOC meanwhile removed PS-21 slips. Installed master bushing.
16:00 - 16:15: WOC meanwhile POOH w/ magnet BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 47 m to 7 m.
16:15 - 16:30: WOC meanwhile insptected magnets, no centralizer piece found. Found cement residues on bottom magnet.

sections.text: Continued displacing cement w/ 12,2 m3 SW. Stopped pumping. Observed 14 bar back pressure in DP, no pressure on annulus.
Opened BOP and stung out of EZSV plug. B/o and l/d pump-in sub. Installed sponge ball and pumped 9,5 m3 SW at 1500 LPM 7 bar.
R/b 1 STD. Dropped 3" drift.
Removed master bushing. Installed PS-21 slips. Turned off TT pump
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 850 m to surface. Average pulling speed 680 m/hr.
Removed drift. Installed master bushing
L/d EZSV RT. Found 1 bow on EZSV RT bow-centralizer missing.
WOC meanwhile serviced drilling equipment.

WOC meanwhile serviced drilling equipment and prepared fishing tools removed masterbushing and inspected diverter and BOP for lost centralizer piece. No findings. performed periodic maintenace on drilling equipment
WOC meanwhile performed TBT for building magnet BHA and retrieving centralizer piece.
WOC meanwhile p/u casing hanger mill assy. B/o string magnet, l/d milling assy. Installed bitsub and flat bottom magnet in fox hole. M/u magnet BHA in rotary.
WOC meanwhile removed master bushing. Installed PS-12 slips
WOC meanwhile RIH w/ magnet BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 7 m to 879m. Restricted running speed 2 min/std.
WOC meanwhile recorded up/down weight 95/89 ton. Continued RIH, took 12 ton weight 2,5 m shallower than EZSV plug at 889m observed wob decreased, possibly soft cement on top of EZSV plug.
WOC meanwhile POOH w/ magnet BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 889 m to 47 m. Restricted pulling speed 2 min/std.
WOC meanwhile removed PS-21 slips. Installed master bushing.
WOC meanwhile POOH w/ magnet BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 47 m to 7 m.
WOC meanwhile insptected magnets, no centralizer piece found. Found cement residues on bottom magnet.
WOC meanwhile b/o bitsub and flat bottom magnet. L/d BHA.
WOC meanwhile r/u equipment for handling guns.
WOC meanwhile performed TBT for handling explosives
WOC meanwhile p/u and m/u 14" perforation guns.
WOC meanwhile RIH w/ 14" guns on 5 1/2" DP to 108m
WOC meanwhile performed TBT with ongoing crew
WOC meanwhile continued RIH w/ 14" guns on 5 1/2" DP from 108 m to 147,5 m. Recorded up/down weight 71/67 ton. P/u XO and m/u TDS
WOC meanwhile filled well from trip tank. No losses observed. Closed UPR confirmed line-up and filled pipe.

WOC meanwhile opened UPR and b/o TDS. Dropped ball. M/u TDS and closed UPR. Pumped with 160 LPM. Guns fired at 132 bar SPP, perforation interval 144,5m 147,5m. Continued to circulate w/ 160 LPM 3 bar. Increased flow rate in steps to 1000 LPM 10 bar. Observed losses. Reduced rate to 750 LPM 6 bar, loss rate 12 m3/hr. MAX 0,65 gas during circulation in gas trap. Circulated 2,5 x b/u, until decreasing gas trend.
WOC meanwhile opened UPR flowchecked well for 10 min, static losses 12 m3/hr.
POOH w/ 14" guns on 5 1/2" DP from 147,5 m to 28m.
Changed handling equipment to handle guns
L/d perforation guns and XO.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor changed handling equipment.
Performed TBT for cutting 14" casing
P/u 14" cutter BHA. Replaced 12 1/8" gauge stab with 12" string mill. Checked knifes and secured same.
